title: G29 Driving Force Shifter: 1st/3rd engage reliably via HID-BPF
objective: The shifter's top row (1st/3rd) rests at hall Y 180-193 on this unit, below the firmware's ~195 engage threshold, so those gears often did not register. A HID-BPF device_event program re-decodes 1st/3rd from the raw X/Y bytes with hysteresis (engage >= 160, release <= 140) and ORs the bit into the button byte before hid-logitech parses it. It never clears a bit, so the firmware's own decode cannot regress. Persistent across boot and hotplug via udev-hid-bpf install, a systemd safety-net unit and an ensure rule. Live on the host since 2026-09-11; this commit puts it under version control.
acceptance_criteria: fix_g29_shifter.sh builds g29_shifter.bpf.c against the udev-hid-bpf headers and --status reports device, persistence, attachment and the safety net
g29_shifter_capture.py records raw hidraw reports and grades a capture per gate (attempts, misses); exit 1 on any miss
test_g29_shifter_capture.py + test_g29_shifter_capture_cli.py pass (29) with g29_shifter_capture.py at 100% branch coverage
every file is under the 250-line cap
out_of_scope: 5th gear (no capture data for the top-right gate; left to the firmware)
